legal.privacyIntro: This notice describes processing performed by the AIONEX AIOS account interface and the registration information required by the platform.
legal.privacy1Copy: Registration sends the name, username, email, date of birth, declared country, international mobile number, consent version, and—when required—a Firebase identity token to AIONEX AIOS.
legal.privacy2Copy: When platform policy requires it, the interface sends available browser, device-capability, language, timezone, network-quality, and referrer signals for identity protection, quota enforcement, audit context, and abuse prevention.
legal.privacy3Copy: Browser-session authentication secrets are held in protected HttpOnly cookies and are not exposed to client-side JavaScript. Uploaded profile images are converted to a data URL and sent through the protected service; supported formats and the 2 MB limit are enforced by the platform.
legal.privacy4Copy: Authenticated support requests are stored in the platform and delivered to authorized recipients. Never include passwords, session tokens, recovery codes, or unnecessary personal data.
legal.termsIntro: These interface terms explain the technical conditions enforced by the current platform. Organization-specific legal terms remain subject to the owner’s approved policy and must not be inferred from this site.
legal.terms1Copy: Use the service only through your own account and within the role, permissions, workspace scope, and limits assigned by the owner.
legal.terms2Copy: Provide accurate registration details, protect your credentials, complete required mobile verification, and never share access or refresh tokens.
legal.terms3Copy: Registration availability, quotas, service access, project limits, and other operational controls are enforced by the platform and may change.
legal.terms4Copy: Use the authenticated support channel for suitable requests and never disclose passwords, session tokens, recovery codes, or confidential content.
legal.terms5Copy: The 3D interface identifies the configured service operator and model provider before generation. When Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.1 is selected, use of the service and its outputs is subject to the Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.1 Community License Agreement and Acceptable Use Policy. Hunyuan is not provided in the European Union, United Kingdom, or South Korea. Hunyuan outputs must not be used to improve any AI model other than Hunyuan 3D 2.1 or its permitted derivatives. Machine-generated content must be identified where the license requires it. Tencent is not affiliated with, sponsoring, or endorsing AIONEX AIOS. When Hunyuan is not licensed or available, AIONEX AIOS may route the request to the MIT-licensed TripoSR fallback.
legal.terms6Copy: Do not evade country detection, model-provider routing, safety controls, or Owner policy. Do not request, access, display, distribute, or share Hunyuan works or outputs outside the territory permitted by its license. Each 3D generation request requires acceptance of the current third-party model terms version. The complete upstream license copies are available below. For Hunyuan use, the restrictions in Sections 5(a) and 5(b), including the incorporated Acceptable Use Policy, are incorporated into and enforceable under these Terms.
legal.privacy5Copy: When you connect a Facebook Page or an Instagram Business account, AIONEX AIOS receives from Meta your name and app-scoped ID, the Pages and accounts you select, and their access tokens. Tokens are stored encrypted and never reach the browser. The granted permissions are used only for what you ask for in the app: publishing and scheduling your posts, showing comments and Messenger and Instagram Direct messages sent to your Pages in the inbox, and replying to them or hiding comments at your request. Meta data is never sold, used for advertising or used to train AI models, and is shared only with the infrastructure providers needed to run the service. An AI reply suggestion sends the conversation text to the AIONEX AI model only when you press the button, and no reply is sent without your approval.
legal.privacy6Copy: You can disconnect any account from the accounts page at any time, which deletes its access tokens immediately. If you remove the app in your Facebook settings or request deletion there, AIONEX AIOS receives Meta’s signed request, deletes the access tokens, disconnects the accounts and erases the stored inbox conversations, then gives you a confirmation code to follow the request.

dataDeletion.title: Data deletion instructions
dataDeletion.intro: How to delete the data AIONEX AIOS received from Facebook and Instagram, and how to check a deletion request.
dataDeletion.step1: In AIONEX: open the social accounts page and choose Disconnect on the Page or account; its access tokens are deleted immediately.
dataDeletion.step2: On Facebook: Settings & privacy → Settings → Apps and websites, then select AIONEX-AIOS and choose Remove.
dataDeletion.step3: To request deletion of all data: on the same screen choose Send request to delete your data. Meta sends a signed request to AIONEX AIOS, which deletes the tokens, the connected accounts and the inbox conversations.
dataDeletion.step4: Meta shows you a link and a confirmation code. Open the link or enter the code below to check the request.
dataDeletion.whatCopy:
The user and Page access tokens are deleted, the Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts are disconnected, the comments and messages stored in the inbox are erased, and your Meta name and picture are removed from the connection record.
Only security audit entries and financial records that the law requires us to keep remain; they contain no access tokens.
dataDeletion.contactCopy: You can also request deletion of your data through the contact page, and the AIONEX AIOS team will answer you.
